title: Jubilees 6 — The Noachic covenant, the Feast of Weeks, and the 364-day calendar

translation.sourceText: Jubilees — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Ge'ez-only for chapter 6; 11Q12 fragmentary touches around the calendar-polemic but not preserved at verse-level for direct citation). Ge'ez per Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511.

paragraphs.text: ወበቀዳማዊ፡ ለሣልስ፡ ወርኅ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ታቦት፡ ወሐነጸ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-qadāmāwi la-śāləs warḫ waḍʾa ʾəm-nə tābot wa-ḥanaḍa məśwāʿa ba-wəʾtu dabr

i18n.en: And on the first day of the third month he went forth from the ark, and built an altar on that mountain.

paragraphs.text: ወአስተሳተየ፡ ምድረ፡ ወነሥአ፡ ምራረ፡ ላሕም፡ አሐደ፡ ወበግዐ፡ አሐደ፡ ወአባግዐ፡ ወሐራጊተ፡ አጋዕዝ፡ ወቅርፈ፡ ናርደ፡ ወቅሌ፡ ወቅርፈ፡ ምክርመም፡ ወሰናኤ፡ ወከስቦን፡ ወሥንዶል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾastasātaya mədra wa-naśʾa mərāra lāḥm ʾaḥada wa-bagʿa ʾaḥada wa-ʾabāgʿa wa-ḥarāgita ʾagāʿz wa-qərfa nārəda wa-qəlē wa-qərfa məkrəmam wa-sanāʾē wa-kasbon wa-śəndol

i18n.en: And he made atonement for the earth, and took one bullock and one ram, and sheep and goats and kids, and offered them up — together with nard, and galbanum, and stacte, and frankincense, and costus, and aromatic spices.

paragraphs.text: ወወደየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሳት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ሠናየ፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wadaya kwəlo lāʿla ʾəsāt zawəsta lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-ʾaʿraga lāʿla maśwāʿta śannāya la-maʿāzā zayətfaqqar qədma ʾəgziʾ

i18n.en: And he set all these upon the fire that was on the altar, and offered them upon the sacrifice — a pleasing savor acceptable before the Lord.

paragraphs.text: ወአጠምቀ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ለማስኖ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaṭamqa ʾəgziʾ la-maʿāzā śannāy wa-ʾaqama bottu kidāna məsla Noḫ kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ la-māsno mədr

i18n.en: And the Lord smelled the pleasing savor, and established a covenant with Noah, that there should no longer be a flood-water to destroy the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ ይብዝኁ፡ ወይብዙኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይኅነጽዋ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ ለፍርሀተ፡ ወለድንጋፄ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē yəbzəḫu wa-yəbzəḫu lāʿla mədr wa-yəḫənaḍəwā wa-yəkunu la-fərhata wa-la-dəngāḍē lāʿla kwəlu zawəstatēhā

i18n.en: And he said: Let them increase and multiply upon the earth, and let them build it up; and they shall be a fear and a dread upon all that is in it.

paragraphs.text: ወኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ወዘሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ ይኩንክሙ፡ ለሲሳይ፡ ከመ፡ ኀመልማለ፡ ሣዕር፡ ወሀብኩክሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለበሊዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kwəlu zayətḥawwas wa-zaḥəyāw wəʾtu yəkunəkəmu la-sisāy kama ḫamalmāla śāʿrə wahabkukəmu kwəlo la-balʿiʿ

i18n.en: And everything that moves and is alive shall be food for you — as the green herb, I have given you all things to eat.

paragraphs.text: ወባሕቱ፡ ሥጋ፡ ምስለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ምስለ፡ ደሙ፡ ኢትብልዑ፡ እስመ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ውስተ፡ ደሙ፡ ይእቲ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይነቅዕ፡ ደምክሙ፡ በነፍሳቲክሙ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ይነቅዕ፡ አንሰ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሰብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bāḥtu śəgā məsla nafsu məsla damu ʾi-təbəlʿu ʾəsma nafsa kwəlu śəgā wəsta damu yəʾəti kama ʾi-yənaqqəʿ daməkəmu ba-nafəsātikəmu ʾəm-nə ʾəda kwəlu sabʾ ʾəm-nə ʾəda kwəlu yənaqqəʿ ʾansa nafsa sabʾ

i18n.en: But flesh with its life — with its blood — you shall not eat; for the life of all flesh is in its blood. And you shall not let your own blood be shed, life for life; from the hand of every man, from the hand of every one, I will require the life of man.

paragraphs.text: ወዘይክዕው፡ ደመ፡ ሰብእ፡ በሰብእ፡ ይክዐው፡ ደሙ፡ እስመ፡ በአርአያ፡ እግዚእ፡ ገብረ፡ ሰብአ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zayəkəʿwə dama sabʾ ba-sabʾ yəkəʿaw damu ʾəsma ba-ʾarʾayā ʾəgziʾ gabra sabʾa

i18n.en: Whoever sheds the blood of a man, by a man shall his blood be shed; for in the image of God he made man.

paragraphs.text: ወአንትሙስ፡ ብዝኁ፡ ወብዝኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾantəmusə bəzəḫu wa-bəzəḫu lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: And as for you, be fruitful and multiply upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡ ዘይነውዕ፡ በውስተ፡ ሥጋ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-maḥala Noḫ wa-wəludu kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama zayənawwəʿ ba-wəsta śəgā

i18n.en: And Noah and his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh.

paragraphs.text: ወመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኪዳነ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ በውእቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ ሣልስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-maḥala Noḫ kidāna ba-qədmēhu ba-wəʾtu warḫ śāləs lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: And in that third month Noah swore the covenant before him upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይቤለከ፡ አኮ፡ ኪያከ፡ ባሕቲተከ፡ ከመ፡ አንበሮ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ አላ፡ እስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ሤመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ኪዳኑ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəbēlaka ʾakko kiyāka bāḥtitaka kama ʾanbaro kidāna məsla daqiqa Noḫ ʾallā ʾəska kwəlu təwlədə śēma lottu śərʿata kidānu la-ʿālam

i18n.en: On account of this it was told to you — not to you alone — that the covenant was established not only with the sons of Noah, but unto every generation he ordained for him the ordinance of his covenant for ever.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ ግበር፡ በዕለታት፡ ኪዳነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta gəbar ba-ʿəlatāt kidāna lāʿla daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama

i18n.en: And you, command the sons of Israel in their days the covenant — that they shall not eat any blood.

paragraphs.text: ወውእቱ፡ ዘይብላዕ፡ ደመ፡ እምነ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእምነ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእምነ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ይትሰረው፡ ብእሲሁ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wəʾtu zayəbəlāʿ dama ʾəm-nə ʾənəssā wa-ʾəm-nə ʾarāwit wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaʿwāf ba-kwəlu mawāʿəla mədr yətsaraw bəʾəsihu wa-bəʾəsitu ʾəm-nə mədr

i18n.en: And the man who eats blood — of cattle or of beasts or of birds — during all the days of the earth, he and his wife shall be rooted out from the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወሤመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወለዘርዑ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēma ʾəgziʾ la-Noḫ wa-la-zarʿu təʾəmərta kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ lāʿla mədr

i18n.en: And the Lord appointed for Noah and for his seed a sign, that there should be no more flood-waters upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ቀስቶ፡ አንበረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደመና፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ለማስኖ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: qastō ʾanbara lāʿla damanā la-səmʿ lāʿla kidāna ʿālam kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ la-māsno mədr

i18n.en: He set his bow in the cloud as a sign of the eternal covenant, that there should no more be flood-waters to destroy the earth.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ወተጸሐፈ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ በዓለ፡ ሰሙናት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ አሐደ፡ ምዕር፡ በዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለትሕድሶ፡ ኪዳን፡ በኵሉ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza wa-taṣaḥafa lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy kama yəgbaru baʿāla samunāt ba-zəntu warḫ ʾaḥada məʿr ba-ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat la-təḥdəso kidān ba-kwəlu ʿāmat la-ʿāmat

i18n.en: For this reason it is commanded and written on the heavenly tablets that they should keep the Feast of Weeks in this month — once a year, year by year — to renew the covenant in every year.

notes.official: The Shavuot etiology: Jubilees presents the Feast of Weeks as the foundational covenant-renewal feast dating back to Noah. The covenant is renewed annually on this date — a uniquely Jubilees framing.

paragraphs.text: ወአልቦ፡ ካልአ፡ በዓል፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘርእ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾalbo kāləʾa baʿāl zayətgabbar lāʿla kwəlomu zarʾ daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām

i18n.en: And there was no other feast kept upon the seed of all the sons of Israel from the days of Noah until the days of Abraham.

paragraphs.text: ወወድቀ፡ ዝንቱ፡ በዓል፡ በሰማይ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ፍጥረት፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ፳ ወ፮ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ወ፭ ሰሙናት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wadqa zəntu baʿāl ba-samāy ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla fəṭrat ʾəska mawāʿəla Noḫ 26 ʾiyobēləwāt wa-5 samunāt

i18n.en: And this feast was kept in heaven, from the days of creation until the days of Noah — twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years.

paragraphs.text: ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ እስከ፡ ፯ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ወ፩ ሰሙን፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ እስከ፡ ሞተ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወእምነ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞቶ፡ ለኖኅ፡ አጥፍኡ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለነገር፡ ቅዱስ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ አብርሃም፡ ወእምነ፡ ዘመነ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡ ይብልዑ፡ ደመ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaqama Noḫ wa-wəludu ʾəska 7 ʾiyobēləwāt wa-1 samun ʾiyobēləwu ʾəska mota Noḫ wa-ʾəm-nə ʿəlata moto la-Noḫ ʾaṭfəʾu daqiqu la-nagar qəddus ʾəska ʿəlata ʾAbrəhām wa-ʾəm-nə zamana Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām yəbəlʿu dama

i18n.en: And Noah and his sons kept it for seven jubilees and one week of years, until the day of Noah's death; and from the day of Noah's death his sons did away with this holy ordinance until the day of Abraham. And from the time of Noah until the days of Abraham, they ate blood.

paragraphs.text: ወአብርሃም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ዐቀቦ፡ ወይስሐቅ፡ ወያዕቆብ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ዐቀብዎ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕሊከ፡ ዘአስሐትከ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾAbrəhām bāḥtitu ʿaqabō wa-Yəsḥaq wa-Yāʿqob daqiqu ʿaqabəwo ʾəska mawāʿəlika zaʾasḥatka

i18n.en: But Abraham alone kept it, and Isaac and Jacob his sons kept it, until your days — when you have forgotten it.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ ግበሮ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ደብር፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ለዓለም፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለልምድ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ በዐሥር፡ ወአርብዓ፡ ቦቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ ይኩንዎ፡ ቡሩከ፡ በዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta gəbaro ba-zəntu dabr śərʿata la-ʿālam la-təwlədomu la-ləməd la-la-ʿāmat ba-zəntu warḫ ba-ʿaśr wa-ʾarbəʿā bottu ʿəlatāt yəkunwo buruka ba-ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat

i18n.en: And you, command them on this mountain as an ordinance for ever for their generations — for a custom year by year, in this month, on the fifteenth day of the month — that they may keep it a blessing, year by year.

paragraphs.text: ወዕለታት፡ ቀዳማዊት፡ ዘወርኅ፡ ዘቀዳማዊ፡ ወዘራብዕ፡ ወዘሣልስ፡ ወዘራብዕ፡ ወዘሳድስ፡ ወዘሳብዕ፡ ወዘሳምን፡ ወዘታስዕ፡ ወዘዓሥር፡ ወዘ፲ወ፩ ወዘ፲ወ፪፡ ይትጸሐፉ፡ ወይትዜከሩ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʿəlatāt qadāmāwit zawarḫ za-qadāmāwi wa-zarābəʿ wa-zaśāləs wa-zarābəʿ wa-zasādəs wa-zasābəʿ wa-zasāmən wa-zatāsəʿ wa-zaʿaśr wa-za-11 wa-za-12 yətṣaḥafu wa-yətzēkaru

i18n.en: And the first day of the first month, and the first day of the fourth month, and the first day of the seventh month, and the first day of the tenth month — these are written down and remembered as the days of memorial.

paragraphs.text: ወአርባዕቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለመዝከር፡ ጽሑፋን፡ በውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʾəmuntu ʿəlatāt la-mazkar ṣəḥufān ba-wəsta ṣəlāta samāy

i18n.en: And these four days are written for memorial in the heavenly tablets.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ ለመዋዕሊሁ፡ ሣልስ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ቦአ፡ ኖኅ፡ ውስተ፡ ታቦት፡ ወእምነ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ሣልስ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ራብዕ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምውስተ፡ ታቦት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaḥadu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu la-mawāʿəlihu śāləs la-warḫ qadāmāwi boʾa Noḫ wəsta tābot wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaḥadu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu la-mawāʿəla śāləs la-warḫ rābəʿ waḍʾa ʾəm-wəsta tābot

i18n.en: And from the new moon of the first month — from these days onward — Noah entered into the ark; and from the new moon of the fourth month he went forth from the ark.

paragraphs.text: ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ እሙንቱ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ጊዚያተ፡ ዓመት፡ ጽሑፋን፡ ወአንበሮ፡ ለ፫ ዘመነ፡ ዓመት፡ ጽሑፋት፡ ለመዝከር፡ ግዕዘ፡ ጊዜያቲሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt ʾəmuntu mawāʿəla giziyāta ʿāmat ṣəḥufān wa-ʾanbaro la-3 zamana ʿāmat ṣəḥufāt la-mazkar gəʿza giziyātihomu

i18n.en: And these four days are appointed as the days of the seasons of the year, and they are inscribed; and he ordained them for the divisions of the year, written as a memorial of the manner of their seasons.

paragraphs.text: ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለዘርዑ፡ በዓለ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለትዝካረ፡ ንስሐ፡ ምድር፡ ወንግሥ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አይኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaqama Noḫ lāʿla ṣəlāta lottu la-zarʿu baʿāla la-la-ʿāmat la-təzkāra nəsḥā mədr wa-nəgəśə mədr ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla ʾāyəḫ

i18n.en: And Noah inscribed them upon tablets for himself and for his seed as a feast — year by year — to be a memorial of the renewal of the earth and the kingship of the earth, from the days of the flood.

paragraphs.text: ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ እሙንቱ፡ ምሰለ፡ ዓመት፡ ወአርባዕቱ፡ ዕለታት፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዘሎንተ፡ ይትዜከሩ፡ ዘይምጽኡ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕገ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt ʾəmuntu məsla ʿāmat wa-ʾarbāʿtu ʿəlatāt mawāʿəla zalonta yətzēkaru zayəmṣəʾu lāʿla kwəlu ḥəga mədr

i18n.en: These four days are the days of the year; and these four days are kept in memorial in all the law of the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወከመ፡ ይኩኖሙ፡ ለትዝካር፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ አሐዱ፡ ለለ፡ ጊዜ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ለ፪ ወ፮ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ ወ፰ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ ለ፪ ወ፬ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡ ወ፪ ወ፯ ሰሙን፡ መዋዕል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kama yəkunomu la-təzkār lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ʾaḥadu la-la-gizē gizēhu la-26 samun mawāʿəl wa-8 samun mawāʿəl la-24 samun mawāʿəl wa-27 samun mawāʿəl

i18n.en: And they are written as a memorial on the heavenly tablets — one in each season — thirteen weeks of days from one to another; from one to another, the four divisions of the year are bound to each other as days of remembrance for all generations.

paragraphs.text: ወአሐዱ፡ ለለ፡ ጊዜ፡ ቅሉጥ፡ እምነ፡ ሰሙን፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ሥርዕት፡ ይከውን፡ መዋዕለ፡ ቀዳማዊት፡ ዘመነ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaḥadu la-la-gizē qəluṭ ʾəm-nə samun ʾiyobēləwu kwəlu ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat la-mawāʿəl śərʿət yəkawwən mawāʿəla qadāmāwit zamana la-la-ʿāmat

i18n.en: And one to each season set apart from the week of the jubilee: the whole year, year by year, for the appointed days — this shall be the first division of the season, year by year.

paragraphs.text: ወአዘዘ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ዓመተ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ፫ ምእት፡ ወ፷ ወ፬ ዕለታት፡ ወይከውን፡ ዓመተ፡ ፍጹመ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያቴይነኒ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ቀዳማዊት፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ በዓላት፡ እስመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ይትገበር፡ በመዋዕል፡ በከመ፡ ስምዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾazaza lomu la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama yəʿqabu ʿāmata wəsta zəntu ḫolaqomu 3 məʾət wa-60 wa-4 ʿəlatāt wa-yəkawwən ʿāmata fəṣṣuma wa-ʾalbo zayāttēynani la-mawāʿəla qadāmāwit la-mawāʿəla baʿālāt ʾəsma kwəlu yətgabbar ba-mawāʿəl ba-kama səmʿ

i18n.en: And he commanded the sons of Israel that they should observe the year according to this reckoning — three hundred and sixty-four days — and these shall constitute a complete year. And no one shall add anything to the appointed days, nor to the days of the feasts; for every thing is done in its appointed time according to the testimony.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ አዝዝ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወይዕቀቡ፡ ዓመተ፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ፫ ምእት፡ ወ፷ ወ፬ ዕለታት፡ ወይከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ዓመተ፡ ፍጹመ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾəzəz la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl wa-yəʿqabu ʿāmata la-la-ʿāmat lāʿla zabottu ḫolaqo 3 məʾət wa-60 wa-4 ʿəlatāt wa-yəkawwən lomu ʿāmata fəṣṣuma

i18n.en: And you, command the sons of Israel that they observe the years according to this reckoning — three hundred and sixty-four days — and it shall be for them a complete year.

notes.official: THE FOUNDATIONAL 364-day calendar verse: 'observe the years according to this reckoning — 364 days, and they will constitute a complete year.' The calendrical-identity-keystone of the Qumran-Enochic-Jubilees corpus.

paragraphs.text: ወይትገሐሡ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እስከ፡ ይትዐደው፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ወዕለታት፡ መዋዕል፡ ወይትዐደው፡ ዓመታት፡ እምነ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በዓላት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgaḥaśu mawāʿəla ʾəska yətʿaddawə bottu kidāna kidāna kwənnānē wa-ʿəlatāt mawāʿəl wa-yətʿaddawə ʿāmatāt ʾəm-nə śərʿatomu wa-yətgaḥaśu ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla baʿālāt

i18n.en: And the days will go astray — until they transgress the covenant, the covenant of judgment; and they will transgress the appointed times of the years from their ordinance, and they will go astray from the days of the feasts.

paragraphs.text: ወይትገሐሡ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሰንበት፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዓመት፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ጊዜ፡ ወመዋዕል፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətgaḥaśu mawāʿəla ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla sanbat wa-yətgaḥaśu kwəlu śərʿata ʿāmat wa-yətgaḥaśu gizē wa-mawāʿəl wa-yətgaḥaśu kwəlu śərʿata samāy

i18n.en: And they will go astray as to the days of the sabbaths, and they will go astray as to every order of the year, and the appointed times and the days; and they will go astray as to all the order of the heavens.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ አንሰ፡ ኣአምር፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ አርእየከ፡ አኮ፡ እምነ፡ ልብየ፡ እስመ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሕልቀተ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትከሠት፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma ʾansa ʾaʾammər wa-yəʾəzēni ʾarʾəyaka ʾakko ʾəm-nə ləbəya ʾəsma maṣḥaf ṣəḥuf qədmēya wa-lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ḥəlqata mawāʿəl yətkaśśat

i18n.en: For I know — and from now on I declare it to you — not from my own heart; for the book is written before me, and on the heavenly tablets the division of days is ordained.

paragraphs.text: ወይሬእዩ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ላዕለ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ወርኅ፡ ወከመ፡ ይሕልዉ፡ ሕሠር፡ መዋዕል፡ ለሥርዐተ፡ ዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yərēʾəyu kwəlomu daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl lāʿla ḫolaqo warḫ wa-kama yəḥəlləwu ḥaśar mawāʿəl la-śərʿata ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat

i18n.en: And all the sons of Israel shall observe the moon for the reckoning of months, and they shall make the moon disturb the seasons — and it shall come ten days short of the ordained year, year by year.

notes.official: The sharpest polemic against the lunar-solar tradition: 'they will make the moon disturb the seasons.' Preserve the polemical voice without softening or pre-resolving the dispute.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይዐርቡ፡ ዓመታት፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ መዋዕሎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወይሬእዩ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ርኵስ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወዕለተ፡ ቅዱስ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ርኵስ፡ እስመ፡ የሐልዉ፡ ወይትገሐሡ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəʿarbu ʿāmatāt lāʿlēhomu wa-yətgaḥaśu mawāʿəlomu ʾəm-nə śərʿatomu wa-yərēʾəyu mawāʿəla rəkws mawāʿəla qəddusa wa-ʿəlata qəddus mawāʿəla rəkws ʾəsma yaḥalləwu wa-yətgaḥaśu śərʿata ʿāmat

i18n.en: On account of this the years shall come upon them out of order, and they shall transgress their days from their ordinance; and they shall reckon an unclean day as a holy day, and a holy day as an unclean day — for they shall err, and they shall confuse the order of the year.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አዝዝ፡ አንተ፡ ወአስምዕ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ካዕበ፡ ካልአ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይትገሐሱ፡ ካዕበ፡ መዋዕለ፡ በዓላት፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡ ምስለ፡ ሥጋ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይትሰዐሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ እምነ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu ʾəzəz ʾanta wa-ʾasmaʿ lāʿlēhomu ʾəsma yətgaḥaśu kāʿba kāləʾa wa-kama ʾi-yətgaḥaśu kāʿba mawāʿəla baʿālāt wa-kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama məsla śəgā wa-kama ʾi-yətsaʿalu mawāʿəla ʾəm-nə śərʿatomu

i18n.en: On account of this, command and testify to them, that they should not go astray again, nor transgress the days of the feasts, nor eat any blood with flesh, nor forget the appointed days from their ordinance.
